in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the ruler or lord of the earth or land

in_marathi.name: Bhumihar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhumihar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who resides on the earth. Derived from the Sanskrit words Bhumi (earth) and Har (dweller).

in_bengali.name: Bhumihar
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhumihar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who resides on the earth. Derived from the Sanskrit words Bhumi (earth) and Har (dweller).
